title: Laboratory testing errors in a general hospital: a 3-year retrospective analysis
core_idea: Identify and quantify types and frequencies of errors across pre-analytical, analytical, and post-analytical phases over a three-year period using retrospective error records and incident reports, classify errors by specimen source, and summarize findings with descriptive statistics and sigma metrics to inform prevention and quality improvement efforts.
tldr: A three-year retrospective study of laboratory error records aimed to characterize error types and frequencies across testing phases and specimen sources, using descriptive statistics and Six Sigma metrics to guide targeted prevention and quality-improvement actions.
